title: Bug : Session exit after shell action execution over SSH/Remote Terminal

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a detailed description, hardware/OS environment info, reproduction steps, and clear expected vs. observed behavior regarding process exit after shell command execution over SSH.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The issue involves platform-specific terminal/PTY handling (node-pty, child_process, raw mode TTY handoff) and is intermittent and environment-dependent on low-resource hardware over SSH.

summary.problem: When running Gemini CLI over SSH/remote terminal connections (e.g. Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W), executing shell actions intermittently causes the session to exit to the system shell rather than returning to the interactive prompt.
summary.root_cause: Race condition during TTY / stdin handoff after PTY or child process execution finishes, causing process.stdin or terminal raw mode state to lose focus or encounter premature EOF/stream closure before the interactive Ink UI re-attaches.
summary.context: Reported on Node.js v24 over SSH on Raspberry Pi OS. Occurs when enableInteractiveShell is active on resource-constrained devices or slow TTY connections.

steps: Ensure process.stdin state and raw mode re-initialization are handled safely following PTY and child process exit.
Add safeguards against premature EOF/stream cleanup during execution lifecycle completion in shell execution handlers.
Verify terminal state restoration in CLI execution lifecycle hook when returning control to the interactive prompt.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The interactive CLI prompt remains active and responsive after executing shell commands without terminating the session.
verification_steps: Test that useExecutionLifecycle correctly restores UI focus and stdin handle after shell command execution completes.
Verify that process exit callbacks are not triggered prematurely during stream cleanup.
